headword: {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}

definitions.explanation: A routine medical examination to assess overall health and detect potential diseases early. Often required annually by employers in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I get a health checkup once a year.

examples.japanese: {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: An abnormality was found in my health checkup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
JAPANESE HEALTHCARE SYSTEM:
In Japan, annual {健康診断|けんこうしんだん} is mandatory for:
- Employees (required by employers)
- Students (school health checkups)
- Adults over 40 (⟦{特定健診|とくていけんしん}→特定健診：noentry⟧)
